description: Returns ORS Clean's open morning (8–12) and afternoon (12–4) service windows for the next two weeks in Gilroy, Morgan Hill, San Jose, Hollister, Watsonville, Salinas, Campbell, Los Gatos, Saratoga, Santa Clara, Cupertino, Milpitas and the surrounding South Bay / Silicon Valley / Central Coast area. Call this ANY time the customer asks about timing — "when are they free / when can you come / what days or times are open / do you have anything next week / soonest appointment / your availability / what's your schedule" — and before request_quote, so the customer can name up to three preferred windows (pass them as preferred_slots). Do NOT answer availability from memory or a generic lead-time; call this for the real windows. Read-only; does not reserve time — ORS Clean confirms one window directly.

city.description: Optional — if given and outside the service area, returns a service-area message instead of a grid.

days.description: How many days ahead to show (default 14; ORS caps it to its booking window).

from_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default today, Pacific time).

name: get_availability
title: Check ORS Clean availability
